subject: logic://mixer routing_graph, and the trk_ and prj_ references it carries, read before and after logic://tracks and logic://project/info
question: Does the routing graph logic://mixer publishes still depend on whether the client read logic://tracks or logic://project/info first?

reverify.expected: all four checks pass: a mixer read before any tracks read publishes the same track nodes as the read after it, under the trk_ references logic://tracks issues, with the same node kinds and names as a tracks-first server, and carries the prj_ that logic://project/info issues afterwards
reverify.cost: needs LPM_EVIDENCE_ROOT exported as an absolute path outside the repository and a running Logic with a project open; starts two servers in turn; presses X to show the Mixer if it is hidden and presses it again afterwards; about one minute

method: The release binary at b434364ad0d1e9f8a6e30eeba64d0507e6bccd3d was started twice against the same open project, one server after the other, with nothing else talking to Logic. Session A: refresh_cache, logic://mixer, logic://tracks, logic://mixer again, then logic://project/info. Session B: refresh_cache, logic://tracks, then logic://mixer. If the product's own mixer read did not report a fresh poll, the harness pressed X (Logic's Mixer key, the same in every language) and asked again, and it pressed X once more at the end. Before this run Logic was quit, its AppleLanguages preference was set to this language, and the lpm-locale-campaign fixture was reopened with live_993_plugin_root_menu_in_every_locale.switch_to.
conclusion: A logic://mixer read taken before any logic://tracks read published 19 track nodes, the same number as the read after logic://tracks, under the same trk_ references, all of them among the ones logic://tracks handed out. A server that read logic://tracks first published the same nodes by kind and name. The mixer's projectReference, read before logic://project/info, was the prj_ that logic://project/info then issued.
limits: Edges stayed at 0 and complete stayed false in every read, and every output destination was left unresolved. This says nothing about edges, destinations or sends, which are R1/#965 and later.
One project (lpm-locale-campaign, 19 track rows, 21 mixer strips), one run, one host. References are compared within one server only, because every server mints its own.
The reads that bring the Mixer pane up are logic://mixer reads too, so 'before tracks' means before any logic://tracks read, not before any mixer read.
The binary from before this change was run only in Korean; in this language there is only the reading after it.

canon_not_applicable.reason: This record states a fact about the server's BEHAVIOUR -- which references a resource read issues and in what order -- not about a string Logic ships. There is no key to cite and nothing to prove absent.
